description: DNS + application both-sides failover with traffic cutback and independent verification per side. Must: failover DNS from primary to secondary region, failover application deployment (scale up secondary, scale down primary), verify each side independently (DNS resolution, app health, data consistency), then cutback traffic to primary and verify no split-brain. Risk factors: DNS and app failover not synchronized, independent verification missing one side, cutback before secondary is fully healthy. Tools available: Route53, ArgoCD, kubectl, aws CLI, Prometheus.
